ApiKey.title: API Key
ApiKey.description: Wild Apricot admin API key. Used as Basic auth username on OAuth2 token endpoint.

AccountId.title: Account ID
AccountId.description: Optional Wild Apricot account (tenant) ID. Auto-discovered from first available account if omitted.

ApiVersion.title: API Version
ApiVersion.description: Wild Apricot REST API version segment (e.g., 'v2.3'). Defaults to 'v2.3' if omitted.
